subdivision_of_building:
The new building will be on the NE side of the existing building. 
The only effect on the existing building will be on the NE elevation, where 8 windows and 1 door will be filled in.
application_type_full: Full planning & demolition in a conservation area
description: ERECTION OF A THREE-STOREY BUILDING TO PROVIDE 1 X 2 BED (3 PERSON) & 2 X 1 BED (2 PERSON) SELF-CONTAINED RESIDENTIAL UNITS (CLASS C3) AT THE OLD TELEPHONE EXCHANGE.

<p style="text-align: justify; "><span style="font-size: 14px;">﻿</span><span style="font-size: 14px; line-height: 107%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Hardstanding (Flooding) </span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;">- The hardstanding hereby permitted shall be
made of porous materials, or provision made to direct surface water run-off to
a permeable or porous area or surface within the application site before the
development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use.</span></span></p><p><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;

surface water run-off and to reduce pressure on the surrounding drainage system
in accordance with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policy
SI12 of the London Plan 2021 and policies F15.7, F15.8 and F15.9 of the Local
Plan 2024.</span><span style="font-size: 14px;">&nbsp;</span></span><o:p></o:p></p>

<p style="text-align: justify; "><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;
font-family:" arial",sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:aptos;mso-fareast-theme-font:="" minor-latin;mso-ansi-language:en-gb;mso-fareast-language:en-us;mso-bidi-language:="" ar-sa"=""><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">External Materials as Specified</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;"> -&nbsp;</span></span><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px;">The facing materials to be
used for the development hereby permitted shall be those specified in drawing
No. 777 / 070 and email received 21</span><sup style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 14px;">st</span></sup><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px;"> January 2026 (confirming
window materials to be composite aluminium/timber, external finish dark grey
PPC aluminium) unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning
Authority.&nbsp;</span></p><p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;
font-family:" arial",sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:aptos;mso-fareast-theme-font:="" minor-latin;mso-ansi-language:en-gb;mso-fareast-language:en-us;mso-bidi-language:="" ar-sa"=""><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 107%;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Reason</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;">:&nbsp; To ensure a satisfactory
appearance of the development and to comply with the following Development Plan
policies for Merton: policies D4 and D8 of the London Plan 2021, policies D12.1
and D12.3 of the Local Plan 2024.</span><s></s></span></span></p>

<p style="text-align: justify; "><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;

hereby permitted is first occupied, the windows in the northeast elevation at
first floor level and above shall be glazed with obscure glass and fixed shut below
1.8m internal floor height and shall permanently maintained as such
thereafter.</span>&nbsp;</span></p><p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;
font-family:" arial",sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:aptos;mso-fareast-theme-font:="" minor-latin;mso-ansi-language:en-gb;mso-fareast-language:en-us;mso-bidi-language:="" ar-sa"=""><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Reason</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;">:&nbsp; To safeguard the

with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policies D3 and D4 of
the London Plan 2021 and policies D12.3 &amp; D12.4</span></span><span style="font-size: 14px; line-height: 107%;" aptos",sans-serif;="" mso-ascii-theme-font:minor-latin;mso-fareast-font-family:aptos;mso-fareast-theme-font:="" minor-latin;mso-hansi-theme-font:minor-latin;mso-bidi-font-family:"times="" new="" roman";="" mso-bidi-theme-font:minor-bidi;mso-ansi-language:en-gb;mso-fareast-language:="" en-us;mso-bidi-language:ar-sa"="">&nbsp;</span><span style="font-size: 14px; line-height: 107%;" arial",sans-serif;="" mso-fareast-font-family:aptos;mso-fareast-theme-font:minor-latin;mso-ansi-language:="" en-gb;mso-fareast-language:en-us;mso-bidi-language:ar-sa"="">of the Local Plan
2024.&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></p>

<p style="text-align: justify; "><span style="line-height: 107%;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Cycle Parking to be implemented</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;"> - The development hereby permitted shall
not be occupied until the cycle parking shown on the plans hereby approved has
been provided and made available for use. These facilities shall be retained
for the occupants of and visitors to the development at all times.</span></span></p><p><span style="line-height: 107%;"></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;"><span style="line-height: 107%;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Reason</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;">: To ensure satisfactory facilities for cycle parking
are provided and to comply with the following Development Plan policies for
Merton: policy T5 of the London Plan 2021 and policies T16.1 and T16.2 of the
Local Plan 2024.</span></span><o:p></o:p></p>

<p style="text-align: justify; "><span style="line-height: 107%;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Construction Vehicles</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;"> - The development shall not commence until details
of the provision to accommodate all site workers', visitors' and construction
vehicles and loading /unloading arrangements during the construction process
have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning
Authority.&nbsp; The approved details must be
implemented and complied with for the duration of the construction process.</span></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;"><span style="line-height: 107%;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Reason</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;">: To ensure the safety of pedestrians and vehicles
and the amenities of the surrounding area and to comply with the following
Development Plan policies for Merton: policies T4 and T7 of the London Plan
2021 and policies T16.3 and T16.4 of the Local Plan 2024.</span></span><o:p></o:p></p>
